title: Jack Gordon's three unnamed aircraft

tellings.quote: I've I've been responsible for 15 real flying uh aircraft in my time.

plain: Jack Gordon, who ran Skunk Works, the secret advanced aircraft division of the company Lockheed in Palmdale, California, told the aviation journalist Nick Cook that he had been "responsible for 15 real flying aircraft", several of which have never been named in public. Cook recounts it from his own meeting with Gordon in the mid 1990s. He tells it as a sign that some flying machines built in secret remain unknown to the public.
